text:
amanda: ok team — proposal: 'Community Code Dojo' launch next month. lightweight weekly tutorials + 1 reference app + a live mentor-led webinar. main asks: launch post, tutorial cadence, refapp repo, webinar registration funnel, and inbound routing. draft checklist below.

james: love it. can we reuse the small-refapp templates? save time on setup. :+1:

sara: +1 to templates. I'll own the tutorial outline (3 short labs, each ~20m). want final copy by EOD Friday so comms can prep.

leo: I can spin up the refapp repo from starter-kit. will add README + quickstart. ETA Tue.

amanda: thanks. webinar idea: 45min demo (20m live build + 15m Q&A + 10m mentor office hours). landing page needs gated form + UTM params. who owns the funnel?

anna: i can own landing & email sequence. suggested subject lines (please react):
- "Join the Community Code Dojo: Build with Redwood Inference"
- "Hands-on: Build a RefApp with Redwood"

nora: for inbound routing — propose: attendees -> nurture list -> convo with solutions-eng if >60% tutorial completion or NPS >= 8. we should tag leads with `dojo_interest` and model-type tag.

james: good. also add a slack invite CTA in post: link to community workspace and #code-dojo channel.

amanda: marketing-bot, please schedule a post draft for review next Wednesday.

marketing-bot: scheduled draft task created: /tasks/4521 assigned to @amanda @anna @sara — review due Wed 09:00 PT.

leo: quick note on metrics: track signups, tutorial completions, refapp stars, webinar attendance, and inbound MQLs routed to SE. set dashboards in Amplitude + HubSpot.

amanda: timeline check:
- Tue: refapp repo ready
- Fri: tutorial draft complete
- Wed(next week): post draft review -> publish Thu -> webinar 2 weeks after publish

anna: email drip plan: 3 emails: confirmation (immediately), 24h pre-webinar reminder, 1 day follow-up with tutorial links + refapp repo. I'll add tracking UTM and HubSpot workflow.

sara: content list for docs repo:
```
/tutorials/dojo-lab-1.md
/tutorials/dojo-lab-2.md
/tutorials/dojo-lab-3.md
/refapps/community-code-dojo/README.md
```

james: small ask — add a short benchmark blurb comparing latency/cost for the demo prompt (helps the dev audience). I can draft numbers from the benchmark kit.

amanda: perfect. action owners: leo (repo), sara (tutorials), anna (funnel & emails), james (bench blurb), nora (routing), me (launch post + runbook). we'll sync Tues 10:30 PT.

leo: linking a helpful checklist I use for refapp launches: https://internal.docs/refapp-launch-checklist :bookmark:

anna: added the initial landing copy to Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/dojo-landing-draft — please comment.

sara: FYI — would like to recruit 2 mentor volunteers from community for the webinar. @james any suggestions?

james: pinging @frank and @mira (they've run similar workshops).

amanda: minor ops detail: keep the refapp under OSS license MIT, add CONTRIBUTING.md for mentor-run sessions.

nora: once we have first cohort, propose a short NPS + optional 5-min survey to capture feedback + prompts for improvements.

amanda: great thread. thanks everyone — see you in the sync. TL;DR: assemble refapp + tutorial drafts this week, landing + email by Fri, publish next Thu, webinar 2 weeks later. :rocket:
